description: For any atom set, a propositional theory \(\Gamma\) of finite formulas is satisfiable if and only if every finite subset of \(\Gamma\) is satisfiable.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.compactness.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
  (Γ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.Theory α) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.TheorySatisfiable Γ ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.FiniteSatisfiable Γ
